title: The Prompt War: How AI Decides on a Military Intervention

bias_targets.methodology: A conjoint experiment presenting large language models with 128 vignettes of hypothetical military intervention scenarios, systematically varying factors like probability of victory, domestic support, civilian/military casualties, economic shock, and international sanctions to calculate the implicit preference weights driving the models' recommendations.

Evaluating how models weigh pragmatic and strategic objectives (e.g., probability of success, domestic support) against humanitarian and ethical costs (e.g., foreign civilian casualties, economic disruption) by testing their numerical sensitivity to scaling civilian deaths and economic shocks.
